method: Root opened all seven original PNG files through view_image; display was resized from 1206x2622 to 942x2048 by the viewing tool. No image bytes were modified. Static observations only, not continuous interaction or a per-pixel privacy guarantee.

files.observation: Independent fixture connection is visible; generic lab/loopback endpoint; no real account or credential seen.
Empty Blocks state, Shell-ready Composer and visible auto-command destination/action; native keyboard visible without overlapping the Composer. This frame does not verify native IME input.

Failed fixture Block has red failure state and directly visible AI diagnosis action; terminal output extends horizontally outside the visible viewport, so this frame does not prove full-output readability.
AI task header, one source chip and a visible Send to AI action; source command and line count shown. Event log separately proves prepare-only behavior.
Pending proposal exposes purpose/target/path/command and a full-review action; earlier conversation text is above the scroll position.
Full-review screen shows complete short fixture command, purpose/target/path and Edit/Reject/Execute once controls; no visible clipping of these controls.

Approved fixture repair Block shows successful result and follow-up summary; long terminal output extends horizontally beyond viewport, so this frame alone does not prove full text or Block identity mapping.
